description:
Write a post in the klyo games community: a question, a request for playtesters, a launch or a game showcase. The post is visible immediately, with no moderation queue, and can be linked to a game from the catalogue (`gra_slug`); then readers get a “play” button.

Examples:
• Write a post on klyo about my game's launch
• Ask for playtesters for my game on klyo games
• Add a showcase of lantern-thief to the community

gra_slug.description: Optional: the catalogue game the post is about.

link.description: Optional: address of the game in a store or on another site.

rodzaj.description: `pytanie` = question | `test` = request for playtesters | `premiera` = launch | `pokaz` = showcase.

tresc.description: Post text, at least 20 characters. Write like a person talking to people, without advertising slogans.

name: klyo_add_post
title: Post in the games community
